title: voiceCalls document
description: Contract for one outbound AI vendor call. Lives in the propagentic-crm Firestore project, collection 'voiceCalls'. The demo UI (docs/call-center.html + docs/call-data.js) creates 'requested' docs and renders everything else in real time; the agent bridge owns all other writes. Field-ownership and lifecycle notes are in BEN-HANDOFF.md.

status.description: Lifecycle. UI writes only 'requested'; the agent bridge owns every transition after that.

createdAtIso.description: ISO-8601 mirror of createdAt for display.

requestedBy.description: Email of the signed-in operator who assigned the call.

brief.description: The structured call brief collected by the UI sidebar.

trade.description: HVAC | Plumbing | Electrical | Roofing | Appliance | General repair

availability.description: Tenant availability painted on the UI week grid.

availabilityText.description: Human-readable summary, e.g. 'Mon 9 AM–1 PM; Wed 2 PM–4 PM'

instructions.description: Prompt composed by the UI from the brief. The production agent MAY substitute its own prompt built from `brief` — the brief is the source of truth, this is a convenience.

guidance.description: Live operator steering (UI appends via arrayUnion). The agent folds unconsumed notes into its next reply and SHOULD mark them consumed.

hangupRequested.description: UI sets true; the agent ends the call when it sees it.

agent.description: Set by the bridge when it claims the request.

transcript.description: Append-only via arrayUnion, one element per finished spoken turn. Matches the voice-agent server's in-memory transcript shape exactly.

role.description: 'assistant' = the AI caller; 'user' = the contractor who answered

outcome.description: THE BUCKETS — the unstructured call turned into structured data. Written by the agent bridge after the call ends: first the deterministic 'fast' pass (regexes, see fastBuckets in docs/call-data.js), then the LLM pass (prompt in BEN-HANDOFF.md) which fills the judgment fields and wins on conflict.

result.description: The one-glance rollup the UI badges are driven by.

scheduled.description: True only for a CONFIRMED visit — not times merely discussed.

termsAccepted.description: Did they accept invoice / net-5 / no-card terms?

handlesTrade.description: Do they do this kind of work?

servesArea.description: Do they cover the property's area?

referral.description: Alternative vendor they suggested, if any.

nextStep.description: One sentence: the concrete next step agreed on the call.

followUps.description: Actions the office owes after this call.

wantsHuman.description: Asked for a person / the owner / management.

sensitiveRequest.description: Asked for card / SSN / payment details.

reviewNeeded.description: Anything a human should look at.

humanRequest.description: If wantsHuman: one short sentence of what they wanted a human for.

summary.description: Two sentences max, written for a property manager.
